title: [MV] Program not responding when editing specific project

posts.author: DARKKDEITY
posts.body:
Hello,
I've been working on a game for quite some time now, and I'm trying to do some polishing on it. For some reason, the project I've been working on crashes often. I will do a few edits in the Event Editor, and it will start not responding soon after.
Right now, I am trying to change an NPC's sprite when you interact with them. At the start of the event, I am trying to put a "Set Movement Route..." command that changes the image. Whenever I am finished setting the movement route, I close back out to the Event Commands page, and it doesn't let me make any inputs. After some time, the entire program will begin to not respond (it doesn't crash completely, just freezes), and I'll have to close it with Task Manager. I tried again and changed something small, and it didn't crash. I thought I was fine, but I just did another similar change to a different event, and it stopped responding while working on the movement route.
I have tried a few things to fix this:
1. Uninstalled/reinstalled RPG Maker MV
2. Freed up 30~ GBs in my C: drive
3. Tried copying files from a backup folder into the main project folder since that project seems to work, but it didn't fix anything
My other projects can be worked on just fine without these issues (at least from the small edits I have made). I've looked some things up to try and figure this out on my own, but I haven't seen anyone come across this specific issue.
Thank you!

posts.author: DARKKDEITY
posts.body: I'd really love some help with this issue. It is still happening, and is slowing down progress on my game greatly. Trying to add some common events to my game, but it keeps crashing almost every time I try to add one. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: I've seen it happen when people have event pages that are thousands of lines long or really large image files.

posts.author: DARKKDEITY
posts.body:
AquaEcho said:
I've seen it happen when people have event pages that are thousands of lines long or really large image files.
Click to expand...
I'm using the GALV Layer Graphics plugin for my custom map art, which has some pretty big images for one of my maps. Do you think that could be what's causing it?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: My magic 8 ball says "Signs point to 'yes'"

posts.author: DARKKDEITY
posts.body:
Alright, thanks! I'll disable the plugin while editing events and I'll see if that helps.
I disabled the plugin and moved the layers folder to a different area and it still crashed. It shouldn't have access to the images anymore, so I'm not sure what's causing the program to crash still. I'll look and see if I can find any more large files that I haven't noticed.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
I think you run out of memory?
MV is 32 bit program so by default it can only use 2GB.
[Finally SOLVED!] RMMV crashes when I apply changes
